ck: (2)petacintaratnan purvapaksanutankayati – nanviti parena prahnana eva visvapetoktervisnurvipina iti vyatikarananityato visnvakyasyeti – kataniti kin pete prananatEkye prananapavatva atye pratyaksatanunanatakanatva tvitiye pratyaksapavatanunanapavatakanapavatvetyarta cetanacetaneti visvapatavyakyanan tatavantarapetopaksepasucanartan cetanacetanatnaketi anyatavantarapetapinanityevavaksyat pinatvaniti petan prati tarnitvan pratiyokitvan cetyarta atra vipratipati isvaratvopalaksita cit civatvopalaksitacitpratiyokikatarnisatasananasatakanOpatikakevalapetavati na vetyatiruhya isvarapratyaksatveneti sasanvantikapatartapratyakse sanpantipratyaksan tantran anyata vayvakasasanyokasya va vayukatasanyokasya va pratyaksatvapata atrapisvareti sutan prahnEva vivaksitan nanu tatvavitpi sakunasya sakarasya pinatvanucyate parapipretan tu prahna nirkunaniti vyatikarano vivata iti cena yatparasya nirkunan tateva tatvata sakuna sakara isvaro na tatotirikta kascititi visesEkyena sananati karanyat etena civacatananatintriyanananatintriyanan canyonyapete pratyaksan nirastan na ca sarvatra yokipratyaksan nanan taca `custan yata pasyati ityatiprasitaniti vacyan akananirasenEva nirasisyananatvat
